settings.tagline: Premium three-piece fashion, curated for women who love effortless elegance.
settings.aboutText: FashioN /w SoniA brings together elegant three-piece looks with carefully selected fabrics, refined detailing and wearable silhouettes. Explore the collection, order online and talk to our fashion agent whenever you need help.

products.name: Sky Blue Embroidered Three Piece
products.description: Elegant sky-blue three piece with detailed embroidery, matching trouser and flowing dupatta.
products.usage: Gentle wash recommended. Follow the garment care label for embroidery.

products.name: Rose Pink Embroidered Three Piece
products.description: Soft rose-pink embroidered kameez, trouser and printed dupatta for graceful occasions.
products.usage: Gentle care recommended; protect the embroidery and dupatta edges.

products.name: Ivory Heritage Three Piece
products.description: Ivory and charcoal traditional three piece with statement embroidery and elegant finishing.
products.usage: Dry clean or follow the garment care label for detailed areas.

products.name: Terracotta Classic Three Piece
products.description: Rich terracotta three piece with printed dupatta and sophisticated eastern detailing.
products.usage: Wash gently and shade dry. Iron inside-out on suitable heat.

products.name: Blush Garden Three Piece
products.description: A refined blush-grey three piece with printed kameez and coordinating dupatta.
products.usage: Gentle wash recommended. Avoid harsh bleach.

products.name: Blue Heritage Signature Three Piece
products.description: A statement blue embroidered three piece with coordinated scarf and premium detailing.
products.usage: Handle embroidery gently and store folded in a dry place.

products.name: Royal Blue Printed Three Piece
products.description: A sophisticated blue three piece with geometric embroidery, matching pants and dupatta.
products.usage: Gentle wash recommended. Follow the care label.

products.name: Ivory Pearl Festive Three Piece
products.description: Elegant ivory festive three piece with delicate printed detailing and flowing dupatta.
products.usage: Prefer gentle wash or dry clean for long-lasting finish.
